posts.title: From FEMA to Systemic Change: The Challenge Ahead
posts.description: Fixing the nation's problems demands a willingness to see beyond partisanship and embrace a systemic vision that offers a choice between patchwork solutions in response to immediate crises and systems change that provides a sturdier foundation for sustainable growth. The post From FEMA to Systemic Change: The Challenge Ahead appeared first on The American Leader .

posts.title: Just Words: No One Owns The Truth
posts.description: Not long after posting to The American Leader’s Facebook page that Virginia Del. posts.title: Just Words: Administration or Regime?
posts.description: Is the Trump government an administration or a regime? The debate has been ongoing since he first took office in 2017 and has only become more relevant in his second term. This article explains why we use the term "regime" to describe the second Trump presidency. The post Just Words: Administration or Regime? appeared first on The American Leader .
